title: Push Sports Event Manager — Mobile-first personal sports event tracker with calendar, payments, reminders, and voice input

requirements.text: Implement single-user event data model and persistence in the Motoko backend, including create/read/update/delete operations for events and derived fields needed by the UI (pendingAmount, payment status, etc.).

quotes: Store data securely for single user
Add New Event form fields including amounts and Pending Amount (Auto Calculate: Total - Advance)

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to create, update, delete, and list events.

Each event stores: name, date, startTime, endTime, location, organizerName, organizerPhone, organizerEmail(optional), totalAmount, advancePaid, eventType, requirements flags, specialNotes, status (Upcoming/Completed/Cancelled).
pendingAmount is computed consistently as totalAmount - advancePaid (never negative).
Data persists across canister upgrades via stable storage patterns (no migration file unless state changes later).

requirements.text: Create a mobile-first dark sports themed UI system and app layout, including a persistent bottom navigation bar with tabs: Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments.

quotes: Mobile first layout
Dark sports theme
Easy bottom navigation bar: Home, Calendar, Add Event, Payments

acceptanceCriteria: App is optimized for small screens first (comfortable touch targets, vertical layouts).
Consistent dark sports theme applied across screens (backgrounds, typography, cards, buttons).
Bottom navigation is always accessible and highlights the active tab.
All user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Build the Dashboard (Home screen) to display: Total Events This Month, Upcoming Events (Next 7 Days), Total Revenue This Month, Total Pending Payments, and quick actions (+ Add New Event, Calendar View).

quotes: DASHBOARD (Home Screen) - Show Total Events This Month - Show Upcoming Events (Next 7 Days) - Show Total Revenue This Month - Show Total Pending Payments - Quick Button: + Add New Event - Quick Button: Calendar View

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows four summary metrics computed from stored events.
Upcoming events list shows events occurring within the next 7 days ordered by date/time.
Quick buttons navigate to Add Event and Calendar screens.
Metrics update after creating/editing/deleting events without requiring a full page reload.

requirements.text: Implement the Add New Event form with all specified fields, validation, and auto-calculation of Pending Amount (Total Event Amount - Advance Paid). Include autosave/draft behavior to prevent losing data on navigation/refresh.

quotes: ADD NEW EVENT FORM Fields Required: ... Pending Amount (Auto Calculate: Total - Advance) ... Requirements (Checkboxes) ... Event Status (Upcoming / Completed / Cancelled)
Offline capable
Auto-save events

acceptanceCriteria: All listed fields are present with appropriate input types (date picker, time picker, numeric inputs, long text, dropdown, checkboxes).
Pending Amount is read-only and updates instantly when Total or Advance changes.
Form prevents saving when required fields are missing (show inline errors).
Autosave stores an in-progress draft locally and restores it when returning to the Add Event screen (with a clear way to discard draft).
On successful save, the new event appears in Calendar/Home/Payments as applicable.

requirements.text: Implement Event Details screen that displays all event information including payment summary and requirements checklist, and provides actions: Edit, Delete, Mark as Completed.

quotes: EVENT DETAILS PAGE Show: - All event information - Payment Summary - Requirements Checklist - Edit Button - Delete Button - Mark as Completed Button

acceptanceCriteria: Details page shows all stored fields in a readable mobile layout.
Payment summary includes totalAmount, advancePaid, pendingAmount and a clear paid/unpaid indicator.
Edit navigates to an edit form populated with the existing event data.
Delete requires confirmation and removes the event from all lists and calendar indicators.
Mark as Completed updates status and is reflected everywhere (dashboard metrics, calendar highlighting, payments list).

requirements.text: Create a Monthly Calendar view that supports selecting a date to view that day’s events list, and selecting an event to open its details. Add visual highlighting rules: upcoming events in green, today’s events in blue, and events with overdue payments marked with a red indicator.

quotes: CALENDAR VIEW (VERY IMPORTANT) - Monthly Calendar View - Show events on selected date - Clicking on a date shows: - List of events for that date - Clicking on an event opens full details page - Highlight: - Upcoming events in green - Today’s events in blue - Overdue payments in red indicator

acceptanceCriteria: Calendar shows a month grid with the ability to move between months.
Selecting a date shows a list of events for that date.
Selecting an event navigates to the Event Details page.
Today’s date and today’s events are visually distinguished in blue.
Upcoming events (future-dated) are visually distinguished in green.
Events with pendingAmount > 0 and event date in the past show a red overdue-payment indicator in the calendar and in the date event list.

requirements.text: Implement a Payments screen that lists all events with pendingAmount > 0, displays total pending amount, and supports filtering by month.

quotes: PAYMENTS SCREEN - List all events with pending amount > 0 - Show total pending amount - Filter by month

acceptanceCriteria: Payments screen only shows events where pendingAmount > 0.
Total pending amount is displayed and matches the sum of listed items under the active filter.
User can filter by month and the list + total update accordingly.
Tapping an event navigates to the Event Details page.

requirements.text: Add an offline-capable storage strategy: cache events locally for fast load and offline access, and sync changes to the Motoko backend when connectivity is available (single-user).

quotes: Store data securely for single user
Offline capable
Auto-save events

acceptanceCriteria: App loads previously fetched events from local storage when offline.
User can create/edit/delete events while offline; changes are queued locally.
When connectivity is restored, queued changes sync to the backend and UI reconciles without data loss.
User has a clear indication when the app is offline and/or when changes are pending sync.

requirements.text: Implement an in-browser reminder system that triggers local notifications (where supported) for: 1 day before an event, the morning of the event, and payment reminders when pendingAmount > 0.

quotes: REMINDER SYSTEM - Send mobile notification 1 day before event - Send notification on event morning - If Pending Amount > 0, show payment reminder notification

acceptanceCriteria: App requests notification permission with a clear explanation and allows continuing without enabling notifications.

When notifications are permitted, the app schedules/checks reminders locally and triggers notifications at the correct times while the app is active (and where the browser permits background notifications).
If pendingAmount > 0, the app shows a payment reminder notification according to a defined rule (e.g., on event morning and/or after event date passes) and does not spam duplicates.
If notifications are not permitted/available, the app shows an in-app reminders panel/badge as a fallback.

requirements.text: Add a voice input feature on the Add Event screen: provide a microphone button that uses browser speech-to-text to capture a spoken booking sentence and auto-fill matching form fields (event name/type/date/time, organizer, amounts, requirements flags, location when stated).

quotes: VOICE INPUT FEATURE - Add microphone button on Add Event page - Allow speech-to-text - Convert spoken input into form fields Example: "Book cricket event on March 15 from 9 AM to 3 PM, Rahul organizer, 5000 advance, needs cafeteria and camera." - Auto-fill matching fields

acceptanceCriteria: Microphone button starts/stops speech recognition and shows listening state.
Recognized text is displayed for review.

App parses common phrases to populate fields (at minimum: eventType from sport words, date, start/end time, organizer name when stated, advance paid, and requirements checkboxes like cafeteria/camera).
User can edit any auto-filled fields before saving.
If speech recognition is not supported, feature degrades gracefully with a helpful message.

requirements.text: Add a simple single-user access approach suitable for personal internal use (no multi-user sharing).

quotes: This app is only for personal internal use (single user access).

acceptanceCriteria: App prevents accidental multi-user use by scoping all data to a single identity/session model (e.g., a single authenticated principal or a single configured owner).
If authentication is used, it relies only on Internet Identity (no third-party auth).
If the user is not the designated user/owner, the app shows an access denied state and does not expose event data.

requirements.text: Generate and include basic static visual assets for the app (icon and a subtle sports-themed background/empty state) and render them from frontend static assets.

quotes: Dark sports theme
Clean and minimal UI

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are placed under frontend/public/assets/generated and used in the UI (e.g., app icon/branding and at least one empty state).
Assets do not require backend routing and load correctly in production build.

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko architecture; place all backend logic in the main actor file specified by the template.

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Use React + TypeScript with Tailwind + shadcn UI components and React Query for data fetching/state as per template stack.
No external databases or third-party notification services; reminders must be implemented with in-browser capabilities and in-app fallbacks.
nonGoals: Multi-user accounts, team sharing, or role-based access control.
True OS-level push notifications that work when the browser/app is fully closed across all platforms (not reliably possible as a pure web app).
Integration with external calendars (Google/Apple) or external messaging (SMS/WhatsApp/email).

required: App icon in a minimal sports style, dark theme with high contrast (app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Empty state illustration for no events scheduled, dark sports theme (empty-events.dim_1200x800.png)
